Every v-html sink renders through DOMPurify.sanitize: lib/markdown.ts (renderMarkdown, renderChartMarkdown) or a component-level renderer (HITLReviewView, CodexFollowupView, DebugPanel, AnalysisPanel, StickyNoteNode, EvalsTestCasesPanel, SkillBuilderModal, DocContent). PluginIcon sanitizes plugin SVG with the svg/svgFilters profile. 2 of the 30 are in frontend docs.

All 21 log a credential id, node id, credential name, Secret pointer or a count (Slack, Discord and Telegram webhook rejections, credential refresh failures, the Kubernetes credential watcher, an LLM output-token-limit warning). None logs a secret value. The watcher's ERROR branch logs a Kubernetes Status message, never a Secret body.
Actions pinned by tag rather than commit SHA across .github/workflows. Supply-chain hardening, not a vulnerability.

13 in services/vector_store_pg.py: the f-strings carry the module constant TABLE (vector_store_items), the constant TEXT_SEARCH_SQL and placeholder-only fragments; every value is bound (:c, :mf, :s, :keep, :after, :k, :t{i}). 4 in alembic/versions/109 and 111: one-time backfill migrations formatting table and column names from a literal tuple, values bound.

lib/utils.ts:85 builds a RegExp from a node label without escaping it, in the editor's own rename path. Only a label the user or a collaborator typed reaches it; escaping the label would make rename robust.

Code node, Python tool and file-sandbox runners. code_runner.py and file_sandbox/runner.py are shipped as source into the sibling sandbox container and never run in the backend process; python_tool_runner.py adds restricted builtins and a code-safety check. Running user code is the feature; the sandbox is the boundary.

Per-run sandbox workspace directories (file_sandbox/workspace.py) opened to the unprivileged sandbox user (uid 65534), and a CA-bundle directory of public certificates (sandbox/ca_bundle.py). Tightening them as the rule suggests would break the sandbox.
